request.text: Shuru mein jab aap ne cake ka example diya, ek bachay ne turant kaha 'hum part karte hain' — woh khud se partition ka concept laaya. Phir kareeb 12 minute par jab aap ne pucha '3,7 ya 7,3 mein se proper fraction kaunsa hoga?', ek bachay ne '3,7' kaha, lekin 'kyun?' par sirf '3,7, 3,7, 3' dharaya. In do alag lamhon mein, un bachon ke sochne ka tareeqa kya badla?
